title: rupicapnos africana subsp. mairei

The health benefits of Rupicapnos africana subsp. mairei include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to act as an emetic, inducing vomiting, and its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rupicapnos africana subsp. mairei include alkaloids, such as berberine, and other compounds like sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
